title: EffectCraft MCP → CI render pipeline adapter contract
purpose: Concrete integration contract and sample adapter showing how EffectCraft's MCP/CLI engine-command interface can be wired into a Git-triggered CI render pipeline. Covers the interface boundary, failure modes from the docs, and the assumptions that must hold for the composition to work.
